evidence: Cic. Phil. 11.28: quā lēge, quō jūre?
Cic. Verr. 2.5.151: quis tibi id permīsit? quō jūre fēcistī?
terms.comment: Cicero’s challenge to an act done without authority, beside quā lēge, “under what law?”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Cicero, Philippics 11.28 and In Verrem 2.5.151, checked against the Perseus Latin texts (12 November 2026).
